content.title: DISH Network dispute update: Where to watch ABC, NBC, CBS, FOX without cable
content.text: DISH customers have lost 226 stations. Find out how to keep watching local TV. (AP Photo/Paul Sakuma, file)ASSOCIATED PRESSIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.On March 10, 2026, DISH Network abruptly lost access to 226 local broadcast stations across 113 U.S. markets due to failed retransmission consent negotiations with Gray Media. Affected channels include affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, CW, MyNetworkTV, Telemundo and various independent Gray Media stations.Find out how DISH users can still watch affected broadcasts and where things now stand for subscribers.How DISH users can still access affected programmingDespite the DISH Network blackout, viewers still have reputable ways to watch their favorite local network programming.Several streaming service bundles include local network coverage, with some offering free trials and low-cost subscription promotions:Fubo: Offers a free trial (variable length) and access to local ABC, CBS and FOX affiliates (availability varies by market). Fubo packages, which start at $73.99 per month, are known for a strong sports lineup and unlimited cloud DVR.Watch Fubo for freeGet Fubo's free trial and up to $30 off your first month of service.Try Fubo FreeDIRECTV: Includes a five-day free trial and major local networks in its base plans starting at $89.99 per month. DIRECTV also carries regional sports networks in many markets.Watch DIRECTV for FreeGet a five-day free trial and up to $40 off your 1st month of service.Try DIRECTV FreeSling TV: Offers a 50% off discount; lower-cost streaming pass options — day, week, weekend, month, year and season — start at $4.99. Monthly pricing begins at $45.99 per month with FOX and NBC featured in select markets. Customizable channel add-ons are also available.Get 50% off Sling TVGet 50% off your first month of SlingTry SlingPeacock TV: NBC’s official streaming service provides next-day access to NBC shows, live sports and select live NBC programming on Premium tiers. Plans start at $7.99 per month, with discounts available on annual subscriptions.Watch Peacock for a low monthly pricePlans start at $7.99/month; Bundle Peacock with Apple TV for $14.99/monthTry PeacockParamount+: Offers live local CBS streaming on its Premium plan, along with NFL on CBS, major sporting events and on-demand CBS shows. Plans start at $8.99 per month, with annual subscription discounts available.Update: What’s next and where things standDISH’s position: EchoStar (DISH’s parent) insists it offered a fair, market-based deal. They emphasize readiness to restore channels once Gray Media reduces their fee demands. Gray Media’s stance: The company claims DISH’s added contract demands were “unprecedented” and that it has a clean negotiation history with other carriers.Possible resolution timeline: Industry analysts point out that such disputes often end with last-minute agreements—sometimes within days—to avoid viewer backlash.Best streaming alternatives detailedFuboPromos: Free trial (length varies) and up to $30 off discounts on first month across plansPricing: Pro: $73.99/moElite: $83.99/moDeluxe: $103.99/moLatino: $14.99/mo Features: 203–294+ channels (ABC, CBS, FOX included)Unlimited Cloud DVRUp to 10 screensStrong sports lineup + 4K on higher tiers DIRECTV Promos: 5‑day free trial and up to $40 off first month depending on plan.Pricing: Entertainment: $89.99/moCHOICE: $94.99/moUltimate: $124.99/moPremier: $169.99/mo Features: 90–185+ channelsDisney+, Hulu (with ads), ESPN Unlimited included (on eligible plans)Unlimited Cloud DVRUnlimited in‑home streamsStrong sports coverage (regional sports networks) Sling TVPromos: 50% off first monthFlexible passes: Day, week, weekend, month and season passes starting at $4.99Pricing: Orange: $45.99/moBlue: $45.99–$49.99/moOrange and Blue: $60.99/moSelect: $19.99–$24.99/mo Features: 30–50+ channels depending on planESPN (Orange), FOX/NBC (Blue)50 hrs DVR (Unlimited DVR +$5/mo)1–4 streams depending on planHighly customizable add‑on packs Peacock TVPromos: Annual plans are eligible for 12 months for the price of 10 promotionPricing: Select: $7.99/moPremium: $10.99/moPremium Plus: $16.99/moFeatures: NBC, Bravo, movies, Originals (Premium & Premium Plus)Live sports on Premium tiersPremium Plus = mostly ad‑free + downloadsSelect tier excludes Originals, movies, sports, and local NBCParamount+Promos:Annual plans are eligible for 12 months for the price of 10 promoPricing:Essential: $8.99/mo (ad‑supported) Premium: $13.99/mo (ad‑free except live TV; includes SHOWTIME) Features:Essential: 40,000+ episodes & moviesStreams on 3 devicesNFL on CBS, UEFA Champions LeagueSelect SHOWTIME series (not full library)Ad‑supported Premium: Everything in EssentialNo ads (except live TV)4K UHD, Dolby Vision, HDR10 on select titlesDownloads for offline viewingFull SHOWTIME libraryLocal CBS live streamingFinal takeThe March 10 blackout marks a significant disruption for DISH subscribers—simultaneously silencing local news, weather, sports, and prime-time programming in 113 markets.
